newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf, Total boosted by buy-back.
newsitem.headline: Elf, Total boosted by buy-back.

text.p: Shares in French oil groups Elf Aquitaine and Total made solid gains and were the most actively traded stocks after the firms confirmed on Thursday that they were considering a share buy-back.

Elf was up 1.98 percent at 566 francs at 0823 and was the most actively traded stock on the Paris bourse, while Total posted a 2.94 percent gain at 479 francs and was the third-most actively traded share.

Total confirmed it had sought authorisation to buy back 15 million shares. At Elf a spokesman confirmed his group was considering a buy-back but could not comment on a report it was seeking permission to buy up to 15 percent.
